verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a guided flow for opening a 'day-one business bank account' with 'no lengthy application, no branch visit, no minimum balance.' It also bundles LLC formation, EIN registration and the account, which points to onboarding in far less than months. However, Gusto says these capabilities are in early beta and will reach more entrepreneurs only 'in the coming months,' and the banking itself is provided by Increase Bank, so availability is limited. Missing for 10: general availability beyond early beta, hands-on evidence of actual onboarding time, independent corroboration beyond restated press claims, and detail on migrating fully from an existing bank (transfers, integrations).
